$description: Golem breakpoints, taken from the canvas widths of the TMP SCR Layout templates in '💠 CORE Templates'. A screen is designed once per breakpoint, not fluidly between them: the templates change navigation style and content column count at these widths, they do not stretch.

golem.source: Figma frame widths of TMP SCR Layout / iOS App, IB Web Small, IB Web Medium, IB Web Large, IB Web Large wide, iPad App Medium portrait and iPad App Large landscape, read 2026-08-12
golem.caution: These are design canvas widths, not CSS media-query cut-offs. Golem does not publish the exact min-width values used in code — confirm with the front-end owner before hard-coding them.

sm.$description: Phone (iOS/Android app) and small web. Single column, bottom navigation, floating toolbar.

md.$description: Tablet portrait and medium web. Single wide column; navigation moves to a side panel on iPad.

lg.$description: Tablet landscape and large web. Side navigation, content plus side column.

lgWide.$description: Wide desktop. Same layout as lg with a wider content area and up to three content columns.
